observation.visible_scene: A dance studio with a pale blue wall, a long horizontal mirror, a ballet barre, hanging willow-like greenery on the left, and ceiling track lights. A woman with brown hair, a sage-green short-sleeved top and a long flowing pale-pink skirt stands with her back partly to the camera, facing the mirror; her mirrored image (a reflection, not a second person) tracks her movements. The camera framing is constant throughout, so apparent motion is the dancer's own.
visible_changes: At the start her hands rest near her hips and her right foot is pointed out to the side; the clip begins mid-pose rather than at a clear onset.
Her arms sweep outward from the hips to the sides, then the left arm rises along a diagonal toward overhead while the right arm extends outward and down.
Both arms continue upward into a raised overhead position as her torso rotates to face the mirror more directly and the pointed right foot draws in.
The raised hands come together above/in front of her head, then lower in front of her face and chest.
Her hands continue down to her waist and settle back on her hips, with feet together and body facing the mirror.

From the hips her arms again extend outward to the sides while her torso turns to a more sideways orientation, ending with arms spread and the right foot pointed; the motion is still ongoing at the last frame.
The mirror reflection reproduces each of these arm, torso and foot changes in sync.
outside_clip_unknowns: What preceded the initial hands-on-hips / pointed-foot position and what follows the final outward arm sweep are not shown.
The overall dance sequence, counts, or intent beyond this excerpt are unknown.
uncertain_details: The exact step terminology (e.g. tendu, port de bras) is not identifiable from poses alone.
Whether the right foot's pointed position is a sustained extension or a passing step is not fully resolved.
The precise axis and amount of torso rotation between the facing-the-mirror and sideways phases is approximate.
